Exercise A

A Year of Festivals

Read the text about festivals in the Midwest. Choose the correct word for each gap.

Reading Text

In autumn, families 3 Thanksgiving on the fourth Thursday of November. They cook a big 4 and say thank you for the harvest.

On the Fourth of July there is a long 5 through the town, and in the evening you can watch 6 over the lake.

In December many houses have colourful 7 in the windows. Every festival is a good chance to meet your 8 and enjoy the day together.

Exercise D

Writing: My Favourite Festival

Write about a festival or holiday that you celebrate (6–8 sentences). Say when it is, who you celebrate it with, what you eat and what you do. Use at least five words from this unit.

Useful language
You can use these: celebrate decorate invite parade fireworks presents decorations neighbours it takes place
Your text
